registered.PI-C-2 (primary, per cost): per lineage, IID group (iid_f0+iid_f2, 512 each): utility(pi_T) >= max(D, always-teacher, R1, R2, random-matched) + .005 AND success(pi_T) >= success(D) - .01; the claim needs 3/3 lineages
registered.PI-C-1 (reported): per lineage, IID group: utility(pi_T) >= utility(D) + .015 AND success(pi_T) >= success(D) - .01

notes: utility is NET of the external delegation cost c x teacher-controlled steps (D pays 0; always-teacher pays every step); utility_gross and delegation_charge are reported
point estimates decide the registered criteria; CIs are world-clustered percentile bootstraps
always-teacher = dep_reuse reference evaluation (lineage-independent; from the x1-r0 / x1-r3 jobs)
